description: Can't decide? Put your options on the wheel, give it a spin, and let randomness choose for you.

faqs.a: It is as fair as your browser's random number generator. Every spin picks a random target angle, so every option has an equal chance.
Yes — between 2 and 12 options. Fewer than 2 can't spin, and more than 12 won't fit readable labels.
faqs.q: How many options can I add?

faqs.a: For entertainment only. The wheel is gloriously random and takes no responsibility for your lunch choices.
faqs.q: Should I trust it with big decisions?

howto: Type one option per line (2 to 12 options).
The wheel draws itself as you type.
Press SPIN and watch it slow down.
The winner is announced with fanfare.
title: Decision Wheel Spinner
